title: Topic posture.stored.v1: decision storage -> gateway (ws), the session's end values are in the DB
description: Published by the decision storage service (backend/processing report) after it writes a session_ended decision (open events, excluded intervals and the session row are closed). A re-delivered session_ended is published again; the gateway ignores sessions it has already closed. The gateway holds the session_ended decision until this arrives (in either order) and then sends it and closed to the app, so a session query after closed already sees the end values (D-67).

end_ms.description: session end, ms from session start (session_ended timestamp_ms)

good_ms.description: good posture time stored for the session, ms (session_ended summary normal_ms)
